purpose: Teach: 結び付け/可変/一望/財務諸表/苦心/降格/行きつけ/委嘱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員を功績に結び付けて評価しろ
lines.en: We evaluate staff based on merit and accomplishment.
lines.style: Measured, declarative. Opens with quiet authority. Precise cadence — each phrase lands with intention. No wasted breath. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。可変料金プランの案を準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared a proposal for the variable pricing plan.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient. Slight formal bow in the voice. Quick report-style delivery. Shows readiness without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新店舗から市街地が一望できる立地を選べ
lines.en: Choose a location for the new store with a clear view of the city center.
lines.style: Directive, clear. No hedging. Spoken as if the decision is already sound. Steady pace, expectant of action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様向けの財務諸表をご提示しました
lines.en: Yes. I've presented the financial statements to our valued clients.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Slightly quicker than before — showing momentum. Warm but formal. Status-update tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、開発に苦心した新製品を世に出せ
lines.en: Get that new product to market — the one we've invested so much in developing.
lines.style: Firmer than previous directives. A hint of investment behind the words. Determined but not harsh. Slight lean forward in tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。問題行動の社員を降格処分にいたします
lines.en: Yes. I'm proceeding with the disciplinary demotion of the problematic staff member.
lines.style: Formal, measured. Delivers difficult news without apologizing for it. Level tone, accepting the weight of the decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様の行きつけのお店を調査しろ
lines.en: Research the favorite establishments of our valued clients.
lines.style: Specific, precise instruction. Spoken as though details matter — they do. Calm but with underlying emphasis on execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。外部監査を委嘱する手続きを進めました
lines.en: Yes. I've moved forward with the procedures for external audit engagement.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Slightly slower pace — marking completion of a phase. Professional satisfaction underneath. Final note of compliance.
